title: Black Smokers
prompt: A classroom explainer where the user supplies the script and forbids any rewording: the temperature figures, the chemosynthesis mechanism and the tubeworm symbiosis are all things they have already checked. Two real research figures are uploaded to be reproduced on screen. The narration is the supplied script VERBATIM — all 243 words, every figure intact, including the one an earlier cut lost (vent fluid does not boil because the pressure at depth is roughly 250x the surface). The script needed more speaking time than the requested 90 seconds, so the film ran to nine shots rather than compress it. Some of the denser diagram labels are misspelled by the image model — in-frame lettering at panel scale is still beyond it.
